Entries.OriginalText: It's not a game                                                                                                                                I'm not a robot AI challenging you
I'm not a phantom                                                                                                                                I'm in your face and I'm here to see it through
And you'll know we were out there                                                                                                                                Swatted lies in the making
Your empire for the taking                                                                                                                                Can't hold on or life won't change
And our voices rang out, here                                                                                                                                Took the mask off to feel free
Fought it out in the debris                                                                                                                                Now we know that life will change
